plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Aucun certificat pour le moment. Pour dé: No certificate yet. To get started:
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Il faut un nom de domaine public qui dés: You need a public domain name pointing to this Jeedom, for example jeedom.mydomain.com. A .local name or an IP address cannot be certified.
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Ajoutez un certificat, saisissez le doma: Add a certificate, enter the domain, and choose DNS-01 validation if your DNS is hosted by a supported provider (OVHcloud): no port to open.
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Faites d'abord « Tester (staging) » : un: First run “Test (staging)”: a full trial, without rate limits, that installs nothing. Then “Get the certificate”.
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Let's Encrypt staging (test, certificats: Let’s Encrypt staging (test, certificates not trusted by browsers)
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.ZeroSSL : laissez ces deux champs vides,: ZeroSSL: leave both fields empty, the plugin obtains the EAB credentials by itself from the e-mail address, then stores them here.
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Seulement si l'autorité exige un compte: Only if the authority requires an external account (External Account Binding); it then provides both values.
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.vide = celui de la configuration du plug: empty = the one from the plugin configuration
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Obligatoire pour ZeroSSL (ici ou dans la: Required for ZeroSSL (here or in the plugin configuration).
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Une clé neuve est générée à chaque renou: A new key is generated at each renewal. RSA only for old clients that do not support ECDSA.
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Vide : au dernier tiers de la durée de v: Empty: at the last third of the certificate lifetime (30 days before the end for a 90-day certificate). Renewal is checked every day.
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.DNS-01 : le plugin prouve qu'il contrôle: DNS-01: the plugin proves it controls the domain by creating a TXT record through your DNS provider’s API. Nothing to open on the router, works for a purely local Jeedom, and allows wildcard names (*.mydomain.com).
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.HTTP-01 : l'autorité vient lire un fichi: HTTP-01: the authority reads a file at http://<domain>/.well-known/acme-challenge/, ALWAYS on port 80 of the public address of the name. You therefore need a router forward “public port 80 → Jeedom:80”. Forwarding another port (for example 9002 → 80) is not enough: the authority only follows redirects to ports 80 and 443. No wildcard names with HTTP-01.
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Dossier servi par le serveur web sur le: Folder served by the web server on port 80. Empty: the Jeedom root.
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Temps maximal d'attente pour que l'enreg: Maximum time to wait for the TXT record to be visible on all DNS servers of the domain.
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Vérifie les clés et les droits auprès du: Checks the keys and rights with the provider using the values entered, without changing anything in the zone.
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Installer automatiquement dans le serveu: Automatically install in the Jeedom web server
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Après chaque émission ou renouvellement,: After each issuance or renewal, the certificate is copied to /etc/ssl/jeedom-acme/ and the web server is configured for HTTPS, then gracefully reloaded.
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Toute visite en http:// part vers https:: Every http:// visit goes to https://, except /.well-known/acme-challenge/ (needed for HTTP-01). Enable only once HTTPS access has been checked.
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Le plugin modifie la configuration du se: The plugin changes the web server configuration, as root. It backs up the existing one, tests the new configuration and rolls back if the test fails; but check https:// access before enabling the redirect, and keep http:// access through the local IP address until then. Disabling or removing the plugin does NOT remove the HTTPS configuration: use “Uninstall from the web server”. With Docker, also publish the container’s HTTPS port.
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Les actions utilisent la configuration e: Actions use the saved configuration: save first. “Test (staging)” performs a full issuance against the Let’s Encrypt test server, without rate limits and without installing anything: do it before the first real request. The PEM files are for a reverse proxy, a NAS or a manual configuration.
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Installez-le dans le serveur web (bouton: Install it in the web server (“Install in the web server” button, or tick automatic installation before getting the certificate). Check that https://<your name> opens without a warning, and only then enable the HTTP to HTTPS redirect.
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Depuis le réseau local, le nom doit dési: From the local network, the name must resolve to Jeedom’s local IP address: local DNS (router, Pi-hole…), or a public A record to the private address, or the router’s NAT loopback. Otherwise the browser will not find Jeedom by that name.
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Un nom par ligne (ou séparés par des vir: One name per line (or comma separated). The first one is the main name. A wildcard name *.mydomain.com requires DNS-01 validation. The name must be public: no name ending in .local, .lan or .home, no IP address.
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Ouvre la page de création de jeton d'OVH: Opens the OVHcloud token creation page for the selected endpoint, with rights limited to the DNS zone (GET, POST, DELETE on /domain/zone/*). Then copy the three keys below.
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Région du compte qui gère la zone DNS. P: Region of the account that manages the DNS zone. For a domain at OVHcloud in Europe: OVHcloud Europe.
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Clé d'application (AK), obtenue avec le: Application key (AK), obtained with the “Create an OVH token” button (OVHcloud createToken page).
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Secret de l'application (AS), affiché un: Application secret (AS), shown only once when the token is created.
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Jeton d'accès (CK). Droits suffisants :: Access token (CK). Sufficient rights: GET, POST and DELETE on /domain/zone/*. Validity: Unlimited (otherwise automatic renewals will fail when the token expires).
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Let's Encrypt n'envoie plus d'e-mail ava: Let’s Encrypt no longer sends an e-mail before a certificate expires: the plugin warns you instead. The Jeedom message centre is always used; add here the commands that should warn you in other ways: mail, Telegram, SMS, mobile app notification, scenario…
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Pour chaque action, cochez les événement: For each action, tick the events that trigger it. A title or message left empty is filled in automatically.
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.L'alerte d'expiration part chaque jour d: The expiry alert is sent every day once the certificate expires in fewer days than the “Alert before expiry” threshold in the plugin configuration, until it is renewed.
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Exécute toutes les actions enregistrées,: Runs every saved action, whatever events are ticked. Save first.
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Équipement désactivé : les boutons fonct: Device disabled: the buttons work, but automatic renewal and daily alerts skip it. Tick “Enable” and save.
plugins/acme/desktop/php/acme.php.Port par lequel on joint Jeedom en HTTPS: Port used to reach Jeedom over HTTPS from the Internet, if your router publishes it on another port (e.g. public port 9003 forwarded to Jeedom:443). The HTTP → HTTPS redirection points to this port. Leave empty if the public port is the same as the HTTPS port.

plugins/acme/desktop/js/acme.js.Ce certificat de test n\\'est reconnu pa: This test certificate is not trusted by any browser and is never installed.
plugins/acme/desktop/js/acme.js.Émettre un nouveau certificat maintenant: Issue a new certificate now, even though the current one is still valid? Let’s Encrypt limits the number of identical certificates per week.
plugins/acme/desktop/js/acme.js.Configurer le serveur web de Jeedom en H: Configure the Jeedom web server for HTTPS with this certificate? The existing configuration is backed up and restored if the test fails.
plugins/acme/desktop/js/acme.js.Enregistrez l\\'équipement avant cette a: Save the device before this action.
plugins/acme/desktop/js/acme.js.Des modifications ne sont pas enregistré: Some changes are not saved: save first, actions use the saved configuration.
plugins/acme/desktop/js/acme.js.Installation dans le serveur web en éche: Installation in the web server failed
plugins/acme/desktop/js/acme.js.Suivi de la tâche abandonné après plusie: Task tracking given up after several failures
plugins/acme/desktop/js/acme.js.Rouvrez l\\'équipement pour relancer le: Reopen the device to resume tracking.
plugins/acme/desktop/js/acme.js.Retirer la configuration HTTPS ajoutée p: Remove the HTTPS configuration added by the plugin? The web server has a single HTTPS configuration: all of Jeedom’s HTTPS goes away, whatever the certificate. Any page opened over https:// (this one included) will stop responding; make sure you have http:// access through the local IP address before continuing.
plugins/acme/desktop/js/acme.js.Les options des actions n\\'ont pas pu ê: The action options could not be displayed. What is saved is kept.
plugins/acme/desktop/js/acme.js.Des modifications ne sont pas sauvegardé: Some changes are not saved: the test uses the saved actions. Save first.

plugins/acme/plugin_info/configuration.p.Chaque certificat est un équipement du p: Each certificate is a device of the plugin: domains, authority, validation method and web server installation are set on its page. The settings below apply to all of them. The level of the “acme” log is set further down, in the Logs panel of this page.
plugins/acme/plugin_info/configuration.p.Transmis à l'autorité à la création du c: Sent to the authority when the ACME account is created, and used by devices that do not set one. Optional for Let’s Encrypt, required for ZeroSSL. Let’s Encrypt no longer sends expiry e-mails since 2025: the plugin warns you instead.
plugins/acme/plugin_info/configuration.p.Détecte le système, le serveur web, Dock: Detects the system, the web server, Docker and the SSL module, and tells whether the plugin can install the certificate by itself. Certificate issuance works everywhere.
plugins/acme/plugin_info/configuration.p.Le plugin peut installer le certificat d: The plugin can install the certificate in the web server of this system.
plugins/acme/plugin_info/configuration.p.L'installation automatique n'est pas pos: Automatic installation is not possible here: the certificate can still be used by downloading it (reverse proxy, NAS, manual configuration).
plugins/acme/plugin_info/configuration.p.Quand un certificat expire dans moins de: When a certificate expires in fewer than this number of days without having been renewed, an alert is sent every day: in the Jeedom message center, and through the actions (mail, Telegram, SMS…) of each device’s Notifications tab. 14 days by default.
